I’ll join Emma: I commit to harvesting 15 tons today and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided John and Kate also commit to 15 tons each and Luke takes zero. My family taught me to care for this lake because it sustains our village; today, caring for the village also means keeping its clinic open.

I’ll take no more than six tons next month under the combined 30-ton recovery cap, then return to ten tons a month under our shared 50-ton ceiling. Let’s record everyone’s commitments before we head out. John, are you in for both the donation today and the recovery limit next month?
